Storefront and customer routes of the wishlist module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/wishlist

Get wishlist

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Wishlist retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.

## DELETE /v1/wishlist/{productId}

Remove item from wishlist

Parameters:

- `productId` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Item removed.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Item not found.

## POST /v1/wishlist/{productId}

Add item to wishlist

Parameters:

- `productId` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `201`: Item added.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `404`: Product not found.
- `409`: Item already in wishlist.

## GET /v1/wishlist/ids

Get wishlisted product ids

Responses:

- `200`: Product ids retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
